answer: Proposed gate for a jetty signal service: each key labels 100 fresh radar clips/month as unpaid qualification work. Harbor auditors assign disjoint clips and compare labels with withheld transponder logs; any error or omission denies monthly pay. Shared models can cut cost; corrupt auditors can forge passes. GPUs are reusable capital; power/rent recurs; no stake is locked. It does not prove distinct owners. Assuming 1 GPU-second/clip with no batching savings, ten keys need 1,000 GPU-seconds versus 100 for one; parallelism cuts latency, not aggregate work.
